title: Curly Hair 12-24-25-c
lyrics:
Curly hair can make you a playa.

Quinton has the curliest hair.
he got the O-highest offer

Sophileeta has long wavy hair,
she's  working hard to make the grade

Ells-a-bells works to make a Frozen shade
And went from build-a-bear to extension hair,

Holden has curls but got it cut to be a grown up
but he loved the waves
yes he loved the waves

Sanderosa had his cut, and sometimes misbehaves
but grew out the curls to be a grownup.  - achieving the highest order of self employed.
Highest order

Paul liked to shave off all curls, but got burned when everyone loved their curls more.
Loved their curls more.

Tara holds the mix together,
She just burns food.
Just.
Burns.
Food!

It's all about the curls
Its all about the curls
